The camera is on the sandy track at a standing man's eye, four long strides behind him, a 35mm lens. The sun comes from BEHIND the far pines. The camera tracks behind <Subject 1> as he strides along the sandy track through the heather toward the ring of sand as the little crowd at the pit grows larger ahead of him at a normal walking pace, from 00:00 to 00:04.
